items.title: ADigital Multinível
items.summary: Real-estate platform with 3-tier commissions, WhatsApp CRM and AI-generated listings.
items.description: End-to-end real-estate management with commissions across up to 3 tiers — that was the challenge behind ADigital Multinível, a freelance platform built with Next.js and TypeScript. Beyond managing properties, sales and affiliates, it connects a CRM to WhatsApp Business, generates listings with AI and brings everything together in real-time dashboards, focused on performance and automation for the real-estate market.

items.title: Abafit
items.summary: Fitness network to log workouts, track progress and compete with friends.
items.description: Logged workouts, tracked progress and friends keeping you going: that's Abafit, a fitness platform I built with Next.js to bring strength training, progress and focus into a single ecosystem. You can compete with friends, share workout playlists and stay consistent with a smooth experience — made for people who take training seriously.

items.title: S.O.P.A
items.summary: ERP, WMS, TMS and CRM unified for food businesses. My FATEC capstone.
items.description: My capstone project for the IT Management degree at FATEC Campinas: S.O.P.A (a process-oriented system for food businesses) unifies ERP, WMS, TMS and CRM in a single Next.js solution to centralize orders, inventory, routes, sales and KPIs. The focus was process automation, fewer operational errors, logistics optimization and a strategic view for managers.

items.title: Dr. Agenda
items.summary: Clinic scheduling SaaS with dashboards, auth and Stripe subscriptions.
items.description: Clinic scheduling and management made simple: Dr. Agenda is a SaaS I built with Next.js while studying at FullStackClub, with several improvements of my own — full CRUD for doctors, patients and appointments, a metrics dashboard, secure authentication and Stripe subscriptions.

items.title: Hidrata+
items.summary: Flutter app to track daily water intake with personalized goals.
items.description: My first Flutter app: Hidrata+ helps you track your daily water intake on Android and iOS, with personalized goals and quick logging. The focus was usability and simplicity, encouraging healthier everyday habits.

items.title: DeepChat
items.summary: Chatbot with 100% local AI, running DeepSeek-R1 through Ollama.
items.description: AI running 100% locally, no cloud required: DeepChat is a chatbot I built with Next.js, integrated with the DeepSeek-R1 model through Ollama, with multi-language support, a responsive interface and real-time control over response generation. A project about privacy, performance and experimenting with open-source LLMs.

timeline.description: I work on full-stack web projects with React, TypeScript and Node.js. My responsibilities include building and maintaining scalable features, integrating external services and writing clean, testable code. I take an active part in architecture decisions, code reviews and agile ceremonies, contributing to a collaborative, high-performance team. I also help improve internal tools and workflows, keeping solutions efficient and easy to maintain.

I focused on building web systems with React and Node.js, working as a full-stack developer across front-end interfaces, APIs and back-end integrations. I took part in proof-of-concept projects and technical challenges, exploring other languages and technologies to broaden my skill set. The experience let me deliver scalable, efficient solutions across several projects.
